findings.text: This is not the real BTCB. On CoinMarketCap, BTCB is Bitcoin BEP2 (rank #7645) and its official BNB Chain contract is 0x7130d2a12b9bcbfae4f2634d864a1ee1ce3ead9c. This contract only copies the name.
Only 9 wallets hold it (CoinMarketCap DEX data), so a handful of people control the market.
Only $3.20 of liquidity in its PancakeSwap pool; the price can be moved or drained easily.
A $10,000 buy would move the price 99.88%. Size down a lot or skip.
PancakeSwap price $0.0000536 vs Atlas Oracle BTC/USD $60379.48: 100% apart. It does not trade like the asset it represents.
Only 0% of the pool's liquidity tokens are burned; the rest could be withdrawn (it may be locked elsewhere, which this check does not see).
Ownership is renounced: no one can change the contract's rules.
Atlas Oracle sources agree: consensus 0.94, healthy. Signature verified against Atlas's official signer; the signed price is part of this answer's on-chain record.
Buy and sell both work. Buy tax 0%, sell tax 0%.

Living Brain recalls 3 related memories: "BTCB Token Contract 0x6583a27d7c7C0d755414b9471BD55EF9a39afd26". On 2026-11-26, CoinGraph Guard rated this BNB Smart Chain token AVOID: it copied BTCB’s name, had approximately $3.18–$3.20 in PancakeSwap liquidity, and showed a 100% price discrepancy against the cited BTC/USD oracle price. A $10,000 buy was estimated to move its price 99.88%.
